text:
Mia: Quick sync — customer X wants a private pilot with 50 sustained QPS and 120ms p95 under load. We need clear launch acceptance criteria and who owns infra/runtime/security signoffs.
Alex: 50 QPS + 120ms p95 is doable if we reserve GPUs and prewarm KV cache. What's the expected avg seq len?
Mia: avg seq ~ 120 tokens, spikes to 600 for long queries. They need embeddings + chat.
Sam: Reserving dedicated GPUs for a customer pilot is fine but we have two competing reserved pools next week. Need commitment window (dates).
Mia: Pilot target start: 2026-04-15, duration 4 weeks. Can we do a temporary slot?
Lee: From platform side we can carve a slot and QC the provisioning automation, but that requires a two-day lead for image bake + cert rollout.
Priya: Product-wise we need canary rollout + rollback criteria. Proposal: canary 10% for 2h, 50% for 6h, then full. Metrics: error rate < 0.5% and latency p95 < 120ms.
Alex: Runtime note — to hit p95 at that seq length we should use quantized 4-bit model variant for the canary and full float for accuracy checks in A/B. That reduces memory and helps autoscale.
Rachel: Security gating: for private pilot we need HSM-backed keys (customer requirement) and an audit trail. Also run the quick threat model and response playbook before rollout. I need confirmation on who signs the threat model.
Mia: I'll draft acceptance doc and attach threat model. Who owns HSM integration?
Sam: Infra owns HSM integration but we'll need PM to open the KMS ticket and provide customer key policies. ETA 3 business days after ticket.
Lee: Platform will add rollout hooks to enforce canary windows and automatic fallback to hosted variant if errors spike. Need a test plan from QA for the fallback path.
Priya: QA will provide a minimal smoke test: 30s ramp to 60 QPS against a staging tenant and token-level cost sanity checks.
Alex: Also adding observability: runtime will enable token-level breakdown, KV cache hit rate, and batch size histogram. These are required for acceptance.
Rachel: Security signoffs required: HSM config review, network ACL review for private ingress, and a short pen-test checklist (low-effort). I'll schedule reviews Wed/Thu.
Mia: Sounds good. Action items: 1) Mia: acceptance doc + threat model by EOD tomorrow. 2) Sam: KMS ticket + temporary slot request (3d) by EOD today. 3) Alex: prepare quantized model image + observability hooks by next Tue. 4) Lee: bake image and add rollout hooks; 2-day lead. 5) Priya/QA: smoke test plan before canary. 6) Rachel: security reviews scheduled.
Sam: noted — I'll flag capacity conflict with 42nd Street reserved pool; if unresolved, we fall back to a smaller slot and shorter pilot.
Alex: If we fallback, runtime will reduce batch size and enable prefix caching to preserve latency. We'll update the acceptance doc with a degraded mode.
Mia: Good call — include degraded acceptance criteria (30 QPS, p95 < 160ms) as fallback.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary (10%) 2026-04-15T10:00Z -> 2h, ramp to 50% -> 6h, full after signoffs. Auto rollback on error_rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Lee: I'll confirm bake window and update infra ticket with exact image name.
Priya: QA will queue the smoke job for 2026-04-14 09:00Z.
Mia: Thanks everyone — I'll circulate the acceptance doc and assign owners. If anyone can't meet ETA, ping here. :thumbsup:
